texte.Cette norme organise la FAÇON de répondr: This standard organises the WAY in which the essential requirements are answered; it is the other drafts of the family that say how to answer them. Buying it in the belief that article # has been dealt with is reaching for the wrong document.
texte.Chaque question porte le paragraphe qui: Each question carries the paragraph it rests on, what it serves to avoid, and the trap met in the field. The locks announce their cap before they are reached.
texte.Coût et empreinte — ce que le FinOps et: Cost and footprint — what FinOps and the AI footprint read here
texte.Descendez les chapitres dans l’ordre : c: Work down the chapters in order: each carries what brings it down in an audit, and each question carries its paragraph number and its title. The batch button answers for a whole chapter when the answer is the same throughout — to be re-read afterwards question by question, because that is where the gaps are. Four answers: met, partly met, absent, not applicable.
texte.Descendez les exigences de votre rôle, p: Work down the requirements for your role, paragraph by paragraph.
texte.Descendez les soixante-cinq paragraphes,: Work down the sixty-five paragraphs, chapter by chapter. The batch button answers for a whole chapter when the answer is the same throughout.
texte.Deux chapitres n’ont d’équivalent dans a: Two chapters have no counterpart in either ISO standard: the regulatory compliance strategy of §#, and operation and control. That is exactly what the Regulation adds to an ordinary QMS.
texte.Deux chapitres n’ont d’équivalent nulle: Two chapters have no counterpart anywhere
texte.Déclarez si vous êtes fournisseur, déplo: Declare whether you are a provider, a deployer or both, and whether the system identifies persons remotely through biometrics.
texte.Elle est au stade de l’Enquête CEN : sa: It is at the CEN Enquiry stage: its reference is NOT cited in the Official Journal of the European Union. Meeting it therefore opens NO presumption of conformity with article #. The day it is cited, the same work will carry a presumption — within the limits of its scope.
texte.Elle ne choisit pas l’approche à votre p: It does not choose the approach for you: the Regulation leaves that choice free, and a module that designated one would have you mistake its opinion for the text. Nor does it hide the cost of the choice: a requirement on « another standard » or « another solution » whose three pieces are missing does not leave the « strategy » share half-done — it caps it, and the cap comes back down onto the overall rate.
texte.Elle ne classe pas les douze risques par: It does not rank the twelve risks by severity: the order is alphabetical in the document, and NIST declined to set a hierarchy. It takes nothing away from the work done on the framework — it bounds what can be said of it for a generative system. And # of the # sub-categories carry no action: they are not applicable FOR THE PROFILE, never « not covered ».
texte.Elle ne masque pas les trois endroits où: It does not hide the three places where the document contradicts itself: two paragraphs of chapter # carry the same title, Annex B labels one of the drafts of the family under a part title that is not its own, and it omits one that this site nevertheless covers. Saying them is better than discovering them in a meeting. And ticking « we meet it » on a bridge is not an audit: it is a declaration, not a certificate.
texte.Elle ne reproduit aucun énoncé de la nor: It reproduces no statement of the standard: the text is the property of CEN, and this module cites its numbers and its titles. The questions are written by the firm. « Not applicable » takes a paragraph out of the calculation; a question WITH NO ANSWER counts as zero, and not as an absence of object — the reverse would make the rate rise as one answers less.
texte.Elle n’ouvre aucune présomption de confo: It opens no presumption of conformity, and that is not a stylistic precaution: this draft is at the CEN Enquiry stage, its reference is NOT cited in the Official Journal of the European Union. Meeting it in full exempts you from no demonstration before a notified body. The day the reference is cited, the same work will carry a presumption — within the limits of its scope.
texte.Elle rend un taux pour chacune des quato: It returns a rate for each of the thirteen frameworks, computed from what you have already filled in across the modules — nothing is reassessed here, everything is composed.
texte.Elles se déclarent toutes les cinq : la: All five of them are declared: the strategy
And the cap is named, with its reason. The difference matters: « you have done # % of the way » is true, « you are at # % of compliance » is false as long as the door is shut. The gross figure stays displayed beside the rate, so that the work already done can be seen.
